Cc: procurement@aetherbio.com
Date: Mon, 01 Nov 2027 09:12:00 -0500
Subject: Renewal / expansion: isolated analytics + dev clusters; term length

Hi Lauren —

Thanks again for the demo last week. We're starting our renewal conversation with procurement and have two requests we'd like to fold into the renewal so we don't run a second provisioning project in Q1: 

- Add a dedicated "analytics" cluster (isolated VPC, EU region preferred) for model scoring and batch embeddings.
- Add a dedicated "dev" cluster (US region) that is single-tenant but not SLA-backed — used for internal dev and smoke tests.
- We're open to moving from 12 → 24 month term if there is a favorable commitment discount and faster provisioning timeline.

Procurement asked for a redline-able term sheet, a technical network checklist, and an updated SOW with delivery milestones and acceptance criteria. I've attached a short procurement checklist and a worksheet with our expected peak qps / token volumes.

Can you confirm feasibility and a ballpark delta to the renewal (capacity + 24mo term) by next Tue (11/9)? Our target is to have a PO issued by 11/15.

Thanks,
Emma
Emma Walsh
Head of Platform Engineering, AetherBio
emma.walsh@aetherbio.com

Subject: Re: Renewal / expansion: isolated analytics + dev clusters; term length

Emma —

Appreciate the clear ask — this is absolutely something we can support. Quick readout and proposed next steps: 

1) Feasibility: Adding two isolated environments (dev in US, analytics in EU) is feasible. We'll provision dedicated clusters behind VPC peering with strict tenancy isolation.

2) Timeline: With a standard on‑boarding path we can deliver dev cluster in ~3 weeks and the analytics cluster in ~5–6 weeks (EU region scheduling dependent). If you need faster delivery we can prioritize for an expediting fee.

3) Term pricing: If you move to a 24‑month term we can offer a 12% committed capacity discount and a one‑time setup credit to offset initial provisioning. Final numbers after we size cluster profiles.

4) Ask from you: please confirm desired peak QPS and retention window for analytics (you attached a worksheet but can you confirm final numbers), and provide the network IP ranges + procurement contact for DocuSign routing.

5) I'm attaching a short SOW template + milestone cadence; I'll loop Karthik for the network/connectivity matrix and Marcus for the capacity-sizing estimate.

If that plan looks good I'll put together an initial commercial delta and a revised SOW by EOD Wed (11/3).

Cheers,
Lauren Bishop
Director, Account Solutions — Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwood.ai

Lauren / Marcus / Emma —

Quick technical notes for sizing and network planning: 

- Analytics cluster (EU) — recommended baseline: 4 x A100-equivalent nodes for batch scoring + 2 x smaller nodes for API serving; anticipate autoscale headroom for daily scoring jobs.
- Dev cluster (US) — 1 x mid-tier GPU node (no SLA) with 2 vCPU worker nodes for CI integration.
- Data retention: if analytics requires 90-day KV cache / intermediate storage we should account for additional storage IOPS and snapshot cadence.
- Network: we need customer-managed IP ranges, allowed egress CIDRs, and whether you require a dedicated private link (we support direct connect / partner interconnect).

Also: what internal access patterns? Will dev cluster need access to the analytics dataset? If so we must design a read-only cross-VPC path or S3 presigned flows.

I'll draft a technical appendix and drop in the Drive link once I have the exact qps/retention numbers from Emma.

-Karthik
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.ai

- IP ranges: 198.51.100.0/24 (EU peering endpoint), 203.0.113.0/25 (US dev).
- Procurement: procurement@aetherbio.com will route PO; they expect a single invoice for the renewal + provisioning fee.
- Timeline: target PO by 2027-11-15; provisioning start ideally the week of 11/22.
